=== version ===
--- version : usbip.exe version
    exit=
    ! A subcommand is required
    ! Run with --help for more information.

=== top-level help (the real syntax) ===
--- --help : usbip.exe --help
    exit=
    | USB/IP client
    | 
    | 
    | C:\Program Files\USBip\usbip.exe [OPTIONS] SUBCOMMAND
    | 
    | 
    | OPTIONS:
    |   -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
    |   -V,     --version           Display program version information and exit
    |   -d,     --debug             Debug output
    |   -t,     --tcp-port TEXT:INT in [1024 - 65535] [3240]  
    |                               TCP/IP port number of USB/IP server
    | 
    | SUBCOMMANDS:
    |   attach                      Attach remote/persistent USB device(s)
    |   detach                      Detach a remote USB device
    |   list                        List exportable/persistent USB devices
    |   port                        Show/stash imported USB devices

=== help for the three subcommands we need ===
--- help list : usbip.exe help list
    exit=
    ! Exactly 1 option from [,[Option Group: Remote],[Option Group: Persistent]] is required
    ! Run with --help for more information.

--- help attach : usbip.exe help attach
    exit=
    ! Exactly 1 option from [,[Option Group: Remote],[Option Group: Stop],[Option Group: Persistent]] is required
    ! Run with --help for more information.

--- help detach : usbip.exe help detach
    exit=
    ! Exactly 1 option from [-p,--port,-a,--all] is required
    ! Run with --help for more information.

--- help port : usbip.exe help port
    exit=
    ! C:\Program Files\USBip\usbip.exe: The following argument was not expected: help
    ! Run with --help for more information.
